email_body:
Dear Donaldson Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Paid Media Strategist role. Your plan to bring paid media in-house and build a regional programme across EMEA is exactly the kind of challenge I want to take on.

In my current roles, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance and improve results. I also have hands-on experience with Google Ads, and I'm comfortable analysing campaign data to make informed decisions. While my paid social experience is still developing, I've worked with LinkedIn and Meta ads in a learning capacity and am eager to deepen my expertise in this area.

What draws me to Donaldson is the opportunity to help shape a new team and contribute to campaigns that reach diverse audiences across Europe. I'm organised, detail-oriented and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to align campaigns with local market needs.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my background can support your paid media goals.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Donaldson Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Paid Media Strategist position. The chance to help establish an in-house paid media programme and manage campaigns across EMEA aligns perfectly with my desire to take ownership of regional campaigns and contribute to a collaborative, innovative team.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've gained hands-on experience in SEO, content and web analytics, using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance and optimise campaigns. I've also worked with Google Ads, managing campaigns and analysing data to improve results. While my paid social experience is still growing, I've engaged with LinkedIn and Meta ads in a learning capacity and am keen to develop this further. My technical background in front-end development and automation gives me a solid foundation for understanding campaign mechanics and implementing tracking solutions.

What particularly attracts me to Donaldson is the opportunity to build something new. I thrive in environments where I can contribute ideas and improve processes, and I'm eager to work with senior team members and regional stakeholders to shape how the paid media function operates. I'm organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines, and I enjoy collaborating across cultures and time zones.

I'm confident that my analytical skills, digital marketing experience and enthusiasm for paid media make me a strong fit for this role. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Donaldson's paid media success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
